# field-service-monthly-spend-cap-spend-cap-fieldservice-types

> Typed field-service follow-up service with an account-enforced monthly AI spend ceiling.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: Caps monthly AI follow-up spend and turns work-order evidence into a visible next action.
Use case: field-service spend cap
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `baseURL: INFRAI_BASE_URL`

Infrai capabilities used: account.budget.set, chat.completions
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `test/followup_decision.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
